num_vertices: <int> Total number of vertices in the undirected graph.
num_edges: <int> Total number of edges in the undirected graph.
edges: <list[list[int]], shape [num_edges][2]> Each edge as a pair of zero-indexed vertex identifiers indicating a direct connection between two vertices.
adjacency_list: <list[list[int]], shape [num_vertices][variable]> For each vertex, the sorted list of zero-indexed identifiers of its neighboring vertices.
